'''2026 Jawa Cup''' was the Players Committee [[Jawa Format]] championship on GEMP, December 2025 – March 2026. [[Justin Miyashiro]] (ISB / Watch Your Step in the Finals) defeated [[Andrew Moss]].<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-03-jawa-cup-dec-2025-to-mar-2026/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Jawa Format]]
* '''Platform:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' December 2025 – March 2026
* '''Forum:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewforum.php?f=1587 2026 Jawa Cup Forum]
* '''Video:''' [https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQSFYZX0M9YT2GfXh-UzVT0r4VU30gAXP Top 8 YouTube playlist]
